job.rawJd: Real Chemistry is looking for an Account Supervisor to join its 21GRAMS healthcare advertising agency. The role can be remote within the United States or based in a U.S. office. The Account Supervisor serves as a primary contact for assigned client accounts, builds client relationships, responds to client questions and concerns, develops strategies with clients and internal teams, and manages day-to-day project operations across timelines, budgets, and resource allocation. The role leads regular client meetings and presentations, reviews progress and upcoming work, identifies new opportunities, and mentors junior team members. The company expects adaptable, accountable, solutions-oriented work, strong prioritization, curiosity, and responsible use of AI. Qualifications include a bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Advertising, or a related field; 2-3 years of Account Management experience; a strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing regulations and FDA guidelines; leadership of cross-functional teams; strong written and verbal communication; detail, organization, and time management; and Microsoft Office proficiency. The posted pay range is $95,000-$110,000. Employees within one hour of a Real Chemistry office are expected in person two days per week; employees without a nearby office may work remotely and meet periodically for team collaboration.
